t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will always appear in pairs which consist of two different coloured gnomes, each different coloured gnome will lead to a different forest which will provide different amounts of mushrooms. The goal is to find out which gnome leads to which forest that provides the most mushrooms. The positions of the gnomes are irrelevant and should be disregarded.

vb_textbox.text: As you go through the different rounds, pay attention to the colours of the different gnomes, they will always appear in the same pairs, for example pink and green, yellow and brown, purple and blue etc. Each gnome will lead you to a different forest, the forests can be light or dark, and in the middle of the forest there will be a coloured basket.Each coloured gnome will lead to a different forest, and each forest and coloured basket within the forest will give you a different amount of mushrooms. It is your job to pay close attention to which coloured gnome leads you to the forest with the highest amount of mushrooms. Be aware that the different poses, shapes and sizes of the gnomes do not matter, the only thing that matters is the colour of the gnome.
